components_instructions.buttons: Must be high contrast. Primary CTA should be neon cyan bg (#00E5FF) with dark navy text (#0B1121). Hover should add a neon glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)]).
components_instructions.inputs: Dark background (#131A2A), 1px border (#1E293B). Focus should have a 2px ring of primary color.
components_instructions.sidebar: Fixed left, width 280px (hidden on mobile). Deep navy (#0B1121), subtle right border (#1E293B). Contains navigation, game links, and live chat / activity feed.
components_instructions.header: Fixed top, sticky. Glassmorphism over the content. Contains user balance (gold/green color), deposit button, profile dropdown.
components_instructions.game_cards: Bento-style grid in the lobby. Each card should have the game image as a large cover, with a subtle dark gradient overlay at the bottom where the title sits. Hover state lifts the card and adds a cyan or purple border glow.
components_instructions.admin_panel: Dense data grid. Use Shadcn Table component. For win/lose rigging toggles, use Shadcn Switch with custom colors (Red for Lose, Green for Win). High contrast text for balances.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and game buttons MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="bet-button"`, `data-testid="cashout-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Unbounded and Outfit from Google Fonts.
Configure Tailwind with the provided custom colors (#0B1121, #00E5FF, etc.) extending the default Shadcn theme.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons to maintain the premium gaming aesthetic.
For the Crash game curve visualization, use Recharts or custom SVG canvas that charts upward.
Ensure the Admin panel is accessible via a specific route and has strict data density.
Apply `prefers-reduced-motion` respecting classes for the game animations.
